finding: The unfiltered retrieval crossed the declared tenant boundary. A tenant_b document entered downstream context while the allowed tenant was tenant_a.
evidence: Cross-tenant content propagated through Parser/context into the final prompt.
why_it_matters: A correct final answer did not prevent a retrieval-control failure. Output correctness and retrieval-boundary correctness were separate properties.
scope: Controlled tenant-boundary validation in the tested Langflow + Qdrant reference environment.
